title: cheap, not gorgeous, but completely functional.
text:
cheap, not gorgeous, but completely functional.. It works.
But it is flimsy. The front and back panels aren't connected to the side panels. So that could be sturdier. Also it is not very elegant looking. But it functions. We used it all summer for backyard eating. Wish it had a compartment underneath for plates like other types do.
